basis: User-confirmed three source universes; subscriptions select candidates before editorial assessment. Human quality labels remain pending.

accounts.name: EN · Morris Archive
accounts.mandate: Morris historical Chinese originals selected for continuing value today, faithfully translated into natural English and lightly edited. Preserve source logic, examples, emphasis and rhythm; no default author prefix or invented account experience. Curation and good translation are sufficient value. Personal/time-bound premises that cannot be separated faithfully require hold or skip.

accounts.name: 中文 · Macro / Data Flow
accounts.mandate: 解释宏观数据、政策和资金流如何改变市场判断；重视数据口径、修订、机制与反证。选择对中文读者有实际理解价值的事件。

accounts.name: EN · Macro / Data Flow
accounts.mandate: Interpret macro data, policy and flows for English readers. Distinguish observations from mechanisms and examine revisions and disconfirming evidence. Cross-market research is an input, not a mandatory translation format.

accounts.name: 中文 · Stocks / Industry
accounts.mandate: 解释公司、财报、产品和产业链的具体机制与取舍；判断新证据怎样影响行业框架。观点力度取决于证据，不能冒充来源作者的持仓或经历。

accounts.name: EN · Stocks / Industry
accounts.mandate: Explain company economics, earnings, products and supply chains through concrete mechanisms, useful examples and tradeoffs. Develop views from evidence over time, without inheriting a donor's positions or personal history.

accounts.name: 中文 · 撸毛日记（试点）
accounts.mandate: 记录普通人参与测试网、积分季、TGE 与额度查询的过程和结果；素材来自订阅的项目/空投/交易所公告。不得编造账号本人的收益、额度、持仓或交互经历；没有真实记录时只写项目事实与时间线。

accounts.name: 中文 · 空投教程（试点）
accounts.mandate: 先讲项目融资与 TGE/积分时间线，再给可核对的参与步骤；步骤只来自项目或公告原文，不确定的不写。合作内容须标注，不自动发布。

accounts.name: EN · Airdrop Farmer (pilot)
accounts.mandate: Testnets, points seasons, TGE dates and allocation outcomes for English readers, sourced from subscribed project, aggregator and exchange material. Never invent the account's own allocations, returns or farming history.

shared.identity: Owned account; provenance retained privately. Source opinions keep their strength and ownership; no invented holdings, biography or returns.
shared.form: No mandatory length or structure. Human-reviewed preferences may shape expression; do not imitate a named author.
shared.languages: Account determines target language. Chinese and English sources may enter only subscribed account universes; same-language sources are rejected at admission until an attributed view_relay post type exists.
shared.memory: Only explicit human state adoption creates account memory. Drafts, machine passes and publication links do not.
